# Dhaatrik Chowdhury — Personal Portfolio & Blog

> Personal website of Dhaatrik Chowdhury, an Entrepreneur and AI Engineer from India. Features a portfolio of projects, pedagogy philosophy, and technical blog posts (called "transmissions"). Site version: v4.0.1.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://dhaatrik.github.io/): Portfolio homepage with project showcases, tech stack, and recent blog posts. Features live blueprint-reveal animations and a unified scroll-reveal system with per-element delay staggering.
- [Personnel](https://dhaatrik.github.io/personnel/): About page with personal background, education, and professional experience.
- [Projects](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/): Dedicated projects index page displaying all 12 software engineering case studies with IMPACT.LOG pain-level meter, fuckup teaser logs, and live telemetry state per project.
- [Pedagogy](https://dhaatrik.github.io/pedagogy/): Teaching philosophy, DBS Classes YouTube channel archive, and educational methodology.
- [Transmissions](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/): Blog index listing all published articles. Features a WAI-ARIA 1.2 combobox search widget (role="combobox", role="listbox", role="option") with multi-term fuzzy matching, #tag shortcut, and keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down/Escape/).

## Blog Posts (Transmissions)

- [Why DeltaV Lab Exists — and What It Actually Is](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/deltav-lab-why-and-what/): Honest origin story — KSP intuition vs. STK price tags, VAB + Mission Control scope, audience, and repo link.
- [The Science Inside DeltaV Lab — Forces, Integration, and Flight Software](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/deltav-lab-science/): RK4 at 50Hz, gravity/thrust/drag/atmosphere, Tsiolkovsky, DSL flight computer, SharedArrayBuffer worker — sourced from the sim repo.
- [Why DeltaV Lab Is Not Professional-Grade (Despite What the README Says)](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/deltav-lab-not-professional-grade/): No published flight V&V, 2D browser limits, simplified environments, gaps from path_to_perfection.md.
- [What Is Next for DeltaV Lab — A Roadmap to Professional-Grade Launch Simulation](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/deltav-lab-whats-next/): Trust ladder, phased V&V/Monte Carlo/HIL plan, NASA M&S V&V framing, commercial toolchain requirements — sourced from path_to_perfection.md.
- [DeltaV Lab Native Physics Core — Escaping the React/TypeScript Ceiling](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/deltav-lab-native-physics-core/): Rust/C++/Python migration plan — WASM for browser UI, native binaries for batch dispersion, strangler-pattern worker rewrite.
- [DeltaV Lab Flight Computer — Teaching Autopilot Without Faking Physics](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/deltav-lab-flight-computer/): WHEN/THEN DSL guidance — parser, condition variables, worker integration.
- [DeltaV Lab Mission Log: RK4, Web Workers, and the KSP Problem](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/deltav-lab-mission-log/): Threading diary — SharedArrayBuffer protocol, chatty postMessage fuckup, 50Hz worker contract (physics deep-dives in separate posts).
- [Why Vellor Exists — and What It Actually Is](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/vellor-why-and-what/): Honest origin — nine years of tutoring, SaaS pain, tutoring-management PWA scope at v4.2.0, not note-taking.
- [Why I Chose This Tech Stack for Vellor — Honest Tradeoffs](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/vellor-tech-stack/): React 19, Zustand 5, Vite 6, AES-GCM localStorage — solo-maintainer constraints and rejected alternatives.
- [Why Vellor Is Free — and What "Zero Terms" Actually Means](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/vellor-free-zero-terms/): MIT license, no subscriptions, no data harvesting — zero SaaS terms is not zero legal text.
- [The Gamification Trap — When Vellor Almost Became a Mobile Game](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/vellor-gamification-trap/): Confetti and ranks vs. invoicing — seasoning, not the meal.
- [Local-Only Backup Reality — No Server Means You Own Disaster Recovery](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/vellor-local-backup-reality/): Export/import, 14-day nudges, encryption without a vendor safety net.
- [Vellor Mission Log: Power-Tutor Ops and the Storage Correction](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/vellor-power-tutor-log/): Operational diary — PWA cache fights, roster performance, admitting IndexedDB was wrong (repo uses encrypted localStorage).
- [Teaching From First Principles: A Mission Log on How I Actually Teach](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/teaching-from-first-principles/): First-person teaching philosophy — observation before equations, sibling-centric trust, and the axiom that knowledge must be free.
- [Why I Started DBS Classes: The Physics of Curiosity](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/why-i-started-dbs-classes/): Origin story of the DBS Classes YouTube channel, founded October 31 2022, to combat rote learning with first-principles physics and mathematics education.
- [How I Teach: Bus Wheels, Kitchen Labs, and Open Skies](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/my-ways-of-teaching/): Mission log on non-traditional teaching — sibling-centric tutoring, kitchen thermodynamics, street-side kinematics, and student psychology.
- [Why I Stopped Uploading: An Honest Audit of Consistency and Flaws](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/why-i-stopped-youtube-classes/): Post-mortem on the DBS Classes YouTube channel cessation — solo production bottleneck, novelty fade, and motivation vs. systems thinking.
- [Why Bill Express — Local POS for Small Retail, Not a Freelancer PDF Toy](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/bill-express-why-and-what/): Full-stack India-GST POS (Express + SQLite) origin story — replacing stale portfolio copy of client-only jsPDF invoicing.
- [Why FinTrack — Mindful Expense vs Personal Investment Tracking](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/fintrack-why-and-what/): Mindful dual-ledger personal finance app v1.0.0 — separating everyday expenses from growth spending with Recharts dashboards, Zustand, and JSON backup.
- [Why FuelDrop — On-Demand Fuel Delivery UX Prototype vs Real Logistics](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/fueldrop-why-and-what/): Frontend-only fuel delivery UX demo v3.0.0 — customer ordering and captain dashboard with Leaflet maps, simulated OTP, and honest mock state.
- [FuelDrop Tech Stack — Client-Only React SPA vs What Needs a Backend](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/fueldrop-tech-stack/): Why FuelDrop v3.0.0 uses React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind 4 + Leaflet — client-only architecture and what real logistics require.
- [FuelDrop Free Demo Scope — Simulated OTP, MIT License, and Real Ops Gaps](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/fueldrop-free-demo-scope/): MIT-licensed fuel delivery UI prototype v3.0.0 — open demo scope, simulated OTP 1234, and missing logistics infrastructure.
- [Why Glassbox Exists — Organizational Feedback Terminal, Not a VM2 Sandbox](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/glassbox-why-and-what/): Cyberpunk internal feedback terminal v4.2.1 — employee signals, Kanban neural grid, MoM metrics, and Gemini sentiment analysis.
- [Why The Infinite Intelligence — Multi-Agent Debate with First-Principles and HITL](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/infinite-intelligence-why-and-what/): Council-of-models workspace v4.0.0 — four-agent squad, Beta Mode, critique rounds, HITL steering, branching, and PDF export via gemma-4-31b-it.
- [Infinite Intelligence Tech Stack — Client Orchestration, @google/genai, Export, Zero Backend](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/infinite-intelligence-tech-stack/): React 19 + Vite 6 + @google/genai with html2canvas/jsPDF export — state machine orchestration without server rent.
- [Infinite Intelligence — API Keys, Rate Limits, and Recursion Depth Guardrails](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/infinite-intelligence-byok-guardrails/): BYOK multi-agent tool v4.0.0 economics — Gemini API key requirements, token costs, round caps, and recursion guardrails.
- [Why I Built a Deep-Link Handoff Tool — and What It Actually Is](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/instant-app-opener-why-and-what/): Next.js web utility v0.2.0 converting social URLs into mobile deep links (copy, Web Share, QR code) — replacing stale Electron tray launcher claims.
- [Why MarkPDF — Zero-Install Markdown to PDF via Browser Print, Not jsPDF](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/markpdf-why-and-what/): Client-only markdown-to-PDF tool v1.0.0 — react-markdown + GFM preview, browser print Save as PDF, and honest print CSS pagination.
- [MarkPDF Tech Stack — react-markdown, Print CSS, and Syntax Highlighting Tradeoffs](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/markpdf-tech-stack/): Why MarkPDF v1.0.0 uses react-markdown + remark-gfm + react-syntax-highlighter with browser print export — rejecting jsPDF and KaTeX.
- [MarkPDF — No Server, No Math (Yet), Browser-Dependent PDF Output](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/markpdf-free-browser-limits/): MIT-licensed MarkPDF v1.0.0 — free and private client-side markdown export with honest limits on LaTeX math and print variance.
- [Why Read Aloud — Article TTS via chrome.tts, Not Cloud Speech APIs](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/read-aloud-why-and-what/): MV3 Chrome extension v4.0.0 — chrome.tts, CSS Custom Highlight API, skip controls, and session storage persistence.
- [Why QR Table Ordering — Customer + Kitchen Surfaces in One Demo](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/seamless-qr-dining-why-and-what/): Next.js 16 contactless dining demo v3.0.0 — QR table join, customer ordering, kitchen dashboard, and React Context order sync (77 Jest tests).
- [Seamless QR Dining Tech Stack — Next.js 16, Context Order Bus, Component Architecture](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/seamless-qr-dining-tech-stack/): Why Seamless QR Dining v3.0.0 uses Next.js App Router and React Context for order sync instead of WebSockets.
- [Seamless QR Dining — What's Simulated vs What a Real Restaurant Would Need](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/seamless-qr-dining-prototype-honesty/): Honest limits of Seamless QR Dining v3.0.0 — in-memory orders, simulated OTP, and production contactless dining gaps.
- [Why Vireo — Wellness UI Today vs the Private Journal I Advertised](https://dhaatrik.github.io/transmissions/vireo-wellness-why-and-what/): Wellness UI demo v2.0.0 — nutrition stats, meal logging, blood glucose charts, simulated devices, and separating vision from shipped scope.

## Projects

Each project page includes: IMPACT.LOG (1–5 neon pain-level bar with ARIA role="meter"), [ FUCKUP LOG ] teaser, SYS.STATUS telemetry, and mission tags.

- [DeltaV Lab](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/deltav-lab/): Open-source browser rocket sim — VAB, Mission Control, 50Hz RK4 worker, DSL flight computer, FTS, telemetry export. Roadmap transmissions cover professional-grade evolution and native physics core migration.
- [Vellor](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/vellor/): Free MIT-licensed offline tutoring-management PWA — students, lessons, payments, invoices, AES-GCM localStorage. Transmission series: vellor-why-and-what, tech-stack, free-zero-terms.
- [FuelDrop](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/fueldrop/): Frontend-only fuel delivery UX demo v3.0.0 — customer + captain, Leaflet, PWA, simulated OTP. Not WebSocket logistics. Transmissions: fueldrop-why-and-what, tech-stack, free-demo-scope.
- [The Infinite Intelligence](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/the-infinite-intelligence/): BYOK multi-agent council v4.0.0 — HITL, branching, PDF export (gemma-4-31b-it). Transmissions: infinite-intelligence-why-and-what, tech-stack, byok-guardrails.
- [Instant App Opener](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/instant-app-opener/): Next.js web app converting social URLs to mobile deep links — copy, Web Share, or QR handoff (v0.2.0). Transmission: instant-app-opener-why-and-what.
- [Glassbox](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/glassbox/): Cyberpunk internal feedback terminal — signals, Kanban neural grid, MoM metrics, Gemini sentiment (v4.2.1). Not VM2 sandbox. Transmission: glassbox-why-and-what.
- [FinTrack](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/expense-vs-investment-tracker/): Dual-ledger finance v1.0.0 — Recharts, Zustand, JSON backup. Not Chart.js. Transmission: fintrack-why-and-what.
- [Seamless QR Dining](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/seamless-qr-dining/): Next.js 16 restaurant demo v3.0.0 — QR table join, kitchen dashboard, Context sync (77 tests). Not WebSocket production. Transmissions: seamless-qr-dining-why-and-what, tech-stack, prototype-honesty.
- [Vireo Wellness](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/vireo-wellness/): Wellness UI demo v2.0.0 — mock meals, glucose charts, simulated devices. Not offline PWA/IndexedDB yet. Transmission: vireo-wellness-why-and-what.
- [Bill Express](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/bill-express/): Full-stack India-GST POS — Express + SQLite, inventory, customers, B2B/B2C invoices (v1.0.0). Transmission: bill-express-why-and-what.
- [MarkPDF](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/free-markdown-to-pdf-converter/): Browser markdown-to-PDF via react-markdown preview and native print export (v1.0.0). No KaTeX/jsPDF. Transmissions: markpdf-why-and-what, tech-stack, free-browser-limits.
- [Read Aloud Chrome Extension](https://dhaatrik.github.io/projects/readaloud_chromeextension/): MV3 chrome.tts extension v4.0.0 — article extraction, highlight, skip controls, 59 tests. Transmission: read-aloud-why-and-what.

## Footer Diagnostics (v4.0.1)

The site footer includes a live system diagnostics block:
- CURRENT_STUDY: Current learning topic (hand-updated; v4.0.1: soil chemistry & crop physiology from first principles)
- LATEST_INSIGHT: Dynamically sourced from the description of the most recently published transmission
- PAGES.INDEXED: Auto-computed from posts + projects + static pages count
- SYS.LOAD: Live CPU core count from navigator.hardwareConcurrency
- SYS.LATENCY: Real page load latency from Performance Navigation Timing API

## Key Entities

- **Dhaatrik Chowdhury**: Founder, author, and developer. Nickname: Dhaatu. Known as "Dhaatu Bhaiyaa" (Big Brother Dhaatu) by students.
- **DBS Classes**: "Dhaatu Bhaiyaa's Classes" — a free YouTube channel for physics and mathematics education. 20 videos published between October 2022 and September 2023.
- **Core Philosophy**: "Education Is Not Free BUT KNOWLEDGE IS FREE" — shared with zero terms and conditions.

## Agent / coding-agent instructions

This repository ships project-scoped skills for AI coding agents (Grok, Antigravity, Cursor-compatible harnesses). Start with [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/dhaatrik/dhaatrik.github.io/blob/main/AGENTS.md) and canonical skill `dhaatrik-seo-legacy`.

| Skill | Scope |
|-------|-------|
| dhaatrik-writing-style | Voice and tone for all user-facing copy |
| dhaatrik-mission-report | Mission Report structure for projects and transmissions |
| dhaatrik-astro-site | Astro 6 architecture, components, tests, deployment |
| dhaatrik-visual-system | Sci-fi mission-control UI and design tokens |
| dhaatrik-seo-legacy | Honest SEO, JSON-LD, OG, sitemap/RSS |

Skills path: `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`
